name: Array Finance
rootCause: The DeFi project Array Finance was attacked by a lightning loan. The attacker used Array Finance's pricing mechanism to rely on aBPT's totalSupply to attack Array Finance. Officials stated that the attacker made a profit of about 272.94 ETH, worth about $515,000.
